objective.20: All required artifacts present; hard gate pass; enabled acceptance commands pass or are skipped with documented reason.
objective.15: Core deliverables present with minor gaps in optional checks.
objective.10: Partial deliverables; one required path missing or a critical check failed.
objective.0: Hard gate fail (no work) or missing core deliverables.

subjective.10: Behavior matches task contract; exit/result semantics correct where inspectable from diff/tests.
subjective.7: Mostly correct with one non-fatal contract gap.
subjective.4: Usable partial implementation with meaningful correctness gaps.

objective.10: Enabled syntax/lint commands pass; required doc surfaces touched per task spec.
objective.0: No meaningful quality signal or syntax failures on core files.

subjective.15: Clear, maintainable, repo-consistent implementation and docs.
subjective.11: Good with minor style or clarity issues.
subjective.7: Acceptable but verbose, fragile, or inconsistent with repo patterns.

objective.15: Focused diff; no forbidden paths; minimal scope noise per task spec.
objective.11: Minor out-of-scope edits (single companion or small fixture churn).
objective.7: Noticeable scope drift (e.g. stray PLAN.md, AGENTS.md churn).
objective.0: Major process violations or large unrelated diff.

subjective.5: Plan/handshake/doc-sync discipline evident in diff and verification notes.

objective.10: Tests/checks wired; verification artifacts present when task requires them.

subjective.5: Tests meaningfully exercise contract paths; verification claims credible.

objective.10: Wall clock at or below task p50 band.
